Whispering Pines is an impressive five-bedroom coastal residence extending to approximately 182 sq. m., set on 0.47 hectares (1.18 acres) with breathtaking views over Dunmanus Bay located in the seafront village of Ahakista. The property includes private sea frontage and mooring, offering an exceptional West Cork lifestyle in a spectacular setting.

SPECIAL FEATURES
o Spectacular panoramic views over Dunmanus Bay
o Private sea frontage and mooring included with the property
o Excellent potential as a family home, coastal retreat or holiday residence
o Sunroom enjoying stunning coastal views
o Set on approximately 0.47 hectares (1.18 acres) of manicured lawns and patio area
o Exceptional setting on the seafront village of Ahakista on the Sheep's Head Peninsula
o Mature hedging along the boundary and traditional stone wall boundary
o Direct access to the coastline and the waters of Dunmanus Bay
o Idyllic location within approx. 600m of local pub and amenities in Ahakista
o The charming village of Kilcrohane, located just 7 km away, provides a range of everyday amenities and services
o Principal bedroom with dual-aspect windows and ensuite bathroom
o Spacious living room with wood-burning stove and attractive stone surround
o Approx. 17.3 km from Bantry and 97.3 km from Cork Airport

DESCRIPTION 
Enjoying an elevated position overlooking the spectacular waters of Dunmanus Bay, Whispering Pines is an impressive five-bedroom detached residence extending to approximately 182 sq. m. (1,959 sq. ft.), set on approximately 0.47 hectares (1.18 acres) in the scenic seafront village of Ahakista, near Kilcrohane on the Sheep's Head Peninsula. This outstanding coastal property, finished with natural stone cladding, benefits from private sea frontage and mooring included with the sale.

Approached via a private driveway, this substantial home enjoys an idyllic setting amid the unspoilt beauty of West Cork. Surrounded by dramatic coastal scenery, rolling countryside and an abundance of scenic walking and cycling trails. Within walking distance of the renowned seafront village of Ahakista.

The generous accommodation is laid out over two floors and is ideally suited to family living or as a spacious coastal retreat. At the heart of the home is a bright and welcoming open-plan kitchen/dining room. The modern kitchen is fitted with custom-built shelving and tiled flooring. The adjoining dining area benefits from dual aspect windows, creating a wonderful space for entertaining and enjoying the breathtaking views across the bay.

The spacious living room features a wood-burning stove set within an attractive stone surround, while the adjoining sunroom provides a peaceful haven from which to admire the ever-changing coastal outlook.

Two bedrooms are located on the ground floor and are served by a family bathroom. Upstairs, there are three further bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with dual-aspect windows and ensuite bathroom, while the remaining bedrooms are served by a family bathroom.

Combining generous proportions, an exceptional coastal setting and spectacular views over Dunmanus Bay, Whispering Pines represents a wonderful opportunity to acquire a substantial home in one of West Cork's most sought-after and unspoilt locations.

GARDENS & GROUNDS
The grounds extend to approximately 0.47 hectares (1.18 acres) and provide a wonderful sense of space and privacy, complementing the exceptional coastal setting of Whispering Pines. The multi-level front garden is beautifully maintained and features manicured lawns, a boat shed with storage space, mature planting and a generous patio area, creating an ideal setting for outdoor entertaining and relaxing while taking in the spectacular views over Dunmanus Bay and Mount Gabriel.

The property enjoys a particularly special connection to the coastline, with private sea frontage and a mooring included with the property. This rare amenity provides an excellent opportunity to enjoy the waters of Dunmanus Bay directly from home, whether for boating, swimming or simply appreciating the peaceful coastal surroundings. Set within one of West Cork's most picturesque coastal settings, it is the perfect place to appreciate the beauty, tranquillity, and natural surroundings of the bay.

The grounds are enclosed by mature hedging and sections of traditional stone wall, enhancing both the privacy and character of the property. With its combination of established gardens, generous grounds, direct coastal access and private mooring, Whispering Pines offers a truly unique setting in one of West Cork's most beautiful locations.

LOCATION
The property is ideally positioned just 600 metres from two popular local pubs, Arundels by the Pier and The Tin Pub. Nearby, a beautiful sheltered cove in Ahakista offers a wonderful spot to enjoy the coastline on foot and take in the stunning surroundings. The renowned Heron Gallery Café, located approximately 1.1 km away, is a favourite destination for coffee, food and leisurely browsing of its attractive gardens. The surrounding area is particularly well known for its scenic walking routes, including the renowned Sheep's Head Way, as well as excellent opportunities for boating, sailing, fishing, swimming and kayaking.

Ahakista is a charming and picturesque seaside village situated on the northern shore of Dunmanus Bay, on the spectacular Sheep's Head Peninsula. With its sheltered coastline, beautiful natural surroundings and relaxed village atmosphere, Ahakista has long attracted those seeking a more peaceful and private way of life. Its unique combination of unspoilt coastal beauty, a welcoming local community and easy access to the water has also made it a favoured retreat for a number of well-known personalities and celebrities, adding to the village's discreet appeal.

Ahakista also hosts its popular annual Regatta Festival over the August Bank Holiday weekend, bringing the village to life with a programme of watersports, boat races, family activities, live music and community entertainment. Ahakista is also renowned for its charity table quiz hosted by television presenter Graham Norton, a hugely popular event which forms part of the village's summer festival and attracts visitors from far beyond West Cork.

The vibrant market town of Bantry is approx. 17.3 km away and provides an excellent range of amenities, including supermarkets, shops, cafés, restaurants, pubs, schools, medical services and other essential services. The charming village of Kilcrohane, located just approx. 7 km away, provides a range of everyday amenities and services, including shops, cafés and local facilities, serving the surrounding community.

Cork Airport is approximately 97.3 km away, while Cork City is approximately 104 km away, providing access to a wide range of cultural, commercial and recreational amenities, as well as national and international transport connections.
